claim: Spotify publishes an annual count of how many artists worldwide generated at least $10,000, $50,000, $100,000, $500,000 and $10 million in royalties each year since 2017 — the only creator-adjacent platform publishing a full earnings-band distribution rather than survey estimates.
stance_target: The claim that platform-disclosed earnings-band telemetry exists and should outrank vendor surveys
scope_conditions: Spotify only; music artists, not general content creators; nine years of data from 2017 through 2025; the band counts are rendered behind an interactive widget and are not present in the page's static text, so the exact per-band counts could not be extracted by crawl
quoted_support: See exactly how many artists are generating different levels of revenue each year. We believe in showing you the full picture. That's why we share a level of royalty data that no other streaming service publishes.

claim: Spotify accounts for roughly 30% of global recorded music revenue as of 2025, up from under 15% in 2017, so single-platform earnings data understates total artist income by roughly a factor of three.
stance_target: The interpretation of single-platform creator earnings as total creator income
scope_conditions: Global recorded music; Spotify's own calculation based on IFPI's 2025 Global Music Report; applies to music, and the analogous multiplier for general content creators is unknown
quoted_support: Spotify accounts for about 30% of global recorded music revenue (up from less than 15% in 2017). So an artist making $10,000 on Spotify likely earned more than $30,000 across all recorded income sources.
numbers: ~30% of global recorded music revenue in 2025

claim: The exact Spotify artist counts per royalty band are served through client-side JavaScript rather than static page text, so the single richest publicly available creator earnings distribution is not machine-readable without browser rendering — an accessibility barrier that helps explain why vendor surveys dominate secondary citation.
stance_target: The availability of high-quality creator earnings data to researchers and journalists
scope_conditions: loudandclear.byspotify.com/payouts as fetched 27 July 2026; audited absence — the band counts exist but require interactive rendering
quoted_support: Click on a dollar amount to see nine years of Spotify royalty data: Go back $10M+ $50K+ $10K+ $100K+ $500K+
